run_optimum_benchmark: run optimum-benchmark with a config directory and config name via CLI
run_optimum_benchmark_disable_logging: run optimum-benchmark with hydra job and hydra logging disabled
run_optimum_benchmark_extra_args: run optimum-benchmark passing extra CLI arguments to the underlying tool
build_optimum_benchmark_wrapper: build a python CLI wrapper that invokes optimum-benchmark with configurable config-dir and config-name
test_optimum_benchmark_wrapper: test the optimum_benchmark_wrapper CLI module with valid config-dir and config-name arguments
